findings.message: dynamically imports code from a variable path
findings.remediation: Use static imports with allowlisted modules; avoid dynamic import() with variable arguments.

findings.message: disables TLS verification or references plaintext HTTP transport (2 occurrences in this file)
findings.remediation: Use HTTPS and keep TLS certificate verification enabled.
findings.impact: Disabling TLS verification or using plaintext HTTP allows MITM interception of all traffic.
findings.attack_vector: rejectUnauthorized: false or http:// URL — attacker can intercept/modify all requests.

findings.remediation: Remove embedded credentials, rotate exposed secrets, and load them only from a protected secret store.
findings.impact: Hardcoded API keys/tokens can be exfiltrated by anyone with read access to the plugin source.
findings.attack_vector: Secret key pattern matched in source — key is shipped in plaintext to all consumers.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: invokes an operating-system process API (4 calls in this file)
